out_of_scope: production queue mutation during verification unless explicitly authorized

commands.actionq.owner.tests: uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_unit.py tests/test_schema.py tests/test_action_resource_owner.py tests/test_completion_outbox.py -q
commands.actionq.contract.tests: uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_application_structure.py tests/test_release_contract.py tests/test_repository_retirement_contract.py tests/test_verification_contracts.py -q

notes: Only low-risk mechanical implementation with frozen interfaces, an externally defined worker-immutable oracle, and coordinator-authored discriminating gates is worker-eligible. Tests or verification intent that define the oracle remain coordinator-only even when their diff is small.

The whole actionq/ package is protected because its surviving modules carry owner authority a worker must not widen: db.py and migrations/ own claim atomicity and the append-only event ledger; application modules own lifecycle and idempotent decisions; cli.py is the public operator write contract; vuoro.py is the served federation surface.

Worker-eligible surface in this repository is therefore tests/ (excluding the authority tests listed above), docs/, verification/contexts/, and README.md. A packet that needs to change actionq/ is a coordinator packet by definition.

Registered commands are the non-PostgreSQL subsets only. 'uv run --extra dev pytest tests' exits 4 in a fresh clone on a host without initdb/pg_ctl, because tests/conftest.py starts a hermetic PostgreSQL whenever the whole tests directory (or an integration/claim_authority/cross_authority path) is selected. A gate that cannot pass cold is not a gate, so no full-suite or integration command is registered; PostgreSQL verification stays with the coordinator.

Registered commands assume a warm uv cache under the worker identity: the worker's network policy is 'disabled', so a cold uv resolve would fail. Prime the cache as the worker uid before the first dispatch.

ActionQ no longer packages a scope-iterate runner, daemon, harness adapter, or HTTP server. agentops hybrid dispatch remains an external controller and must not invoke actionctl or the retired dispatcher-once compatibility launcher from a worker packet.
